violations.text: Cooked lobster meat and imitation crab meat were observed held in the walk-in cooler with intact reduced oxygen packaging (ROP). Seafood items packaged in ROP packaging shall be completely removed from their original packaging prior to thawing to allow the reintroduction of oxygen into the food item for safety. Food items were observed held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit during the time of inspection and were voluntarily disposed. Guidance provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back hallway by the dry storage area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/02/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the walk-in cooler door. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/02/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the dishwashing and food storage hallway have coving that is in poor repair. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch and must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/02/2026
